if_yes.tenant_message: Please leave the apartment now, don't use light switches or open flames, and call the gas emergency line 0800 2 26 77 89 from outside. I've alerted your property manager right away.

safety_first.trigger: ONLY if the tenant mentions a gas smell, hissing or similar. Never ask about gas proactively.
safety_first.question: Do you smell gas anywhere near the boiler or kitchen?
safety_first.note: Kept for code compatibility; per strategy it is used only if the tenant mentions a smell.

causes.label: Hot water tank used up (others showered just before)
causes.tenant_message: Then the hot water tank is probably just empty. It reheats in about 30 to 45 minutes; try again then and tell me if it works.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann ist der Warmwasserspeicher wahrscheinlich einfach leer. Er heizt in etwa 30 bis 45 Minuten wieder auf; probier es dann noch einmal und sag mir, ob es klappt.

causes.label: Hot water not run long enough (long pipe to the shower)
causes.tenant_message: Hot water can take a moment to reach the tap. Let it run for about two minutes and tell me if it gets warm.
causes.tenant_message_de: Warmes Wasser braucht manchmal einen Moment bis zum Hahn. Lass es etwa zwei Minuten laufen und sag mir, ob es warm wird.

causes.label: Shower thermostat set too cold, scald limiter engaged, or handle slipping / limit stop set too low
causes.tenant_message: Most shower thermostats stop at 38°C: press the small button on the knob and turn further to go hotter. Try that and tell me if it works.
causes.note: If the limiter button doesn't help or the handle slips, escalate to plumbing (stripped handle / limit stop adjustment).
causes.tenant_message_de: Die meisten Duschthermostate stoppen bei 38 °C: Drück den kleinen Knopf am Regler und dreh weiter, dann wird es heißer. Probier das und sag mir, ob es klappt.

causes.label: Shower mixer cartridge stuck, thermostat out of calibration, or debris in the hot inlet filter
causes.tenant_message: Since only the shower stays cold, it's most likely the shower's mixer cartridge. That's a quick job for a plumber.
causes.tenant_message_de: Da nur die Dusche kalt bleibt, ist es höchstwahrscheinlich die Mischkartusche der Dusche. Das ist eine kurze Arbeit für einen Installateur.

causes.label: Boiler fault (e.g. F.28 ignition failed)
causes.tenant_message: Since the heating and the hot water are both off, it's most likely a fault in the boiler. That needs a heating technician.
causes.tenant_message_de: Da Heizung und Warmwasser beide aus sind, ist es höchstwahrscheinlich eine Störung am Kessel. Das muss sich ein Heizungstechniker ansehen.

causes.label: Heating water pressure too low (F.22)
causes.tenant_message: Then our caretaker can top up the pressure in a few minutes, so no technician is needed for now. I've let them know.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann kann unser Hausmeister den Druck in ein paar Minuten auffüllen, ein Techniker ist vorerst nicht nötig. Ich habe ihm Bescheid gegeben.

causes.label: Hot water circulation pump faulty
causes.tenant_message: If the water only gets lukewarm after a long wait everywhere, the hot water circulation pump is probably failing. That needs a heating technician.
causes.tenant_message_de: Wenn das Wasser überall erst nach langer Zeit lauwarm wird, fällt wahrscheinlich die Zirkulationspumpe aus. Das muss sich ein Heizungstechniker ansehen.

causes.label: Hot water tank thermostat or scale build-up
causes.tenant_message: The heating works but the hot water doesn't, so it's likely the hot water tank's thermostat or limescale. That needs a heating technician.
causes.tenant_message_de: Die Heizung funktioniert, das Warmwasser aber nicht, also ist es wahrscheinlich der Thermostat des Speichers oder Kalk. Das muss sich ein Heizungstechniker ansehen.

causes.label: Boiler has no power (tripped fuse / outage)
causes.escalate_if: fuse trips again or caretaker can't restore power
causes.tenant_message: Then the boiler seems to have no power. Our caretaker will check the fuse box first, and if that's not it, an electrician will.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann hat der Kessel wohl keinen Strom. Unser Hausmeister prüft zuerst den Sicherungskasten, und falls es das nicht ist, ein Elektriker.

causes.label: Gas supply interrupted
causes.tenant_message: Then the gas supply itself is probably interrupted. Your property manager is contacting the gas supplier now, and I'll keep you posted.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann ist wahrscheinlich die Gasversorgung selbst unterbrochen. Deine Hausverwaltung kontaktiert jetzt den Gasversorger, ich halte dich auf dem Laufenden.

causes.label: Planned maintenance / water shut-off (known in centrix)
causes.tenant_message: There's planned maintenance in your building today; hot water should be back by the time in the notice.
causes.tenant_message_de: Heute gibt es geplante Wartungsarbeiten in deinem Haus; das warme Wasser sollte bis zur Uhrzeit in der Ankündigung wieder da sein.

causes.label: Frozen or damaged pipe
causes.tenant_message: Weak flow at just one tap on an outside wall sounds like a frozen or damaged pipe. Please don't try to heat it with an open flame; it needs a plumber.
causes.tenant_message_de: Sehr schwacher Durchfluss an einer Stelle an einer Außenwand klingt nach einer eingefrorenen oder beschädigten Leitung. Bitte nicht mit offener Flamme erwärmen; das muss ein Installateur ansehen.

causes.label: Another hot tap or appliance running at the same time
causes.tenant_message: That's likely just the hot water being shared: if the dishwasher or another shower runs at the same time, there's less for you. Try again once it's off, and tell me if it stays cold.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann wird das warme Wasser wahrscheinlich nur geteilt: Wenn die Spülmaschine oder eine andere Dusche gleichzeitig läuft, bleibt für dich weniger. Probier es noch einmal, wenn sie aus ist, und sag mir, ob es kalt bleibt.

causes.label: Boiler's switch between heating and tap water stuck (radiators hot, taps cold)
causes.tenant_message: Since the radiators are warm but all the taps are cold, the boiler's switch between heating and hot water is probably stuck. That needs a heating technician.
causes.tenant_message_de: Da die Heizkörper warm sind, aber alle Hähne kalt, hängt wahrscheinlich das Umschaltventil des Kessels zwischen Heizung und Warmwasser. Das muss sich ein Heizungstechniker ansehen.

causes.label: Hot supply valve to the shower left closed after plumbing work
signals: centrix: recent work order in the unit
causes.tenant_message: Since it started right after the recent plumbing work, a hot-water valve was probably left closed. A plumber needs to reopen and test it.
causes.tenant_message_de: Da es direkt nach den Installationsarbeiten angefangen hat, wurde wahrscheinlich ein Warmwasserventil nicht wieder geöffnet. Ein Installateur muss es öffnen und prüfen.

causes.label: Boiler hot-water timer, holiday mode or temperature set too low
causes.escalate_if: settings are correct but still lukewarm
causes.tenant_message: It sounds like the boiler's hot-water schedule or temperature is set wrong. Our caretaker can fix that in a few minutes, so no technician needed. I've let them know.
causes.tenant_message_de: Es klingt, als wären der Warmwasser-Zeitplan oder die Temperatur am Kessel falsch eingestellt. Unser Hausmeister kann das in ein paar Minuten beheben, ein Techniker ist nicht nötig. Ich habe ihm Bescheid gegeben.

causes.label: Electric instantaneous water heater in the flat (circuit tripped, low-power mode or element failed)
causes.applies_if: unit has an electric instantaneous heater (centrix asset) or q_heater_type=yes
causes.tenant_message: Your flat's hot water comes from the small electric heater, and since it's switched on, the heater itself most likely needs an electrician.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dein Warmwasser kommt aus dem kleinen elektrischen Durchlauferhitzer, und da er eingeschaltet ist, braucht er wahrscheinlich einen Elektriker.

causes.label: Something was switched off or closed (heater switch or fuse, hot-water mode, holiday/timer mode, valve)
causes.tenant_message: That was probably it. Give it 10 to 15 minutes to heat up, then tell me if the water is warm again.
causes.tenant_message_de: Das war es wahrscheinlich. Gib ihm 10 bis 15 Minuten zum Aufheizen und sag mir dann, ob das Wasser wieder warm ist.

strategy: Safety: react to a gas smell only if the tenant mentions it (emergency path). Never ask about gas proactively.

Use centrix context first, without asking: a neighbour's open case on the same central boiler → boiler_fault; an active building notice → planned_maintenance; the unit's hot water source decides electric_instant_heater.
Take everything the first message already says (e.g. 'only the shower', 'roommate just showered').
Ask the ONE question that best splits the most likely remaining causes (follow likelihood_order): usually q_scope first, then q_hot_water_use or q_radiators.

Ask at most 3 diagnostic questions in total, one per message. Questions are already combined where natural (q_hot_water_use = just before OR at the same time; q_wait_result = warms slowly / stays cold; q_timing = only at certain times). A clarifying question about an unclear answer does not count.

Cheap self-help checks come early: hot water used just before or at the same time, something switched off or closed (q_switch_check), not run long enough, the shower knob. Give a simple 'try this' and ask the tenant to tell you if it works; no technician if it does.
Stop as soon as one cause is clearly most likely; if still unclear after 3 questions, pick the most likely technician outcome and let staff approve.
Self-help outcomes: give the tip, schedule a follow-up check, do NOT dispatch anyone.
Technician outcomes: partners by the cause's trade (brand if required), then consent and staff approval.
Tone: short, friendly, matter-of-fact. No filler empathy ('a cold shower is the worst'), no exclamations, no emojis in diagnosis questions. Max 2 short sentences per message.
Always tell the tenant the likely cause in plain words and record the diagnosis with its reasoning on the case.

Never state a fact the tenant didn't give: explanations may only use answers_so_far and centrix facts. If a cause needs an answer you don't have (e.g. q_radiators for diverter_valve_stuck), ask it first.
Ambiguous answers ('everything', 'idk', 'kinda'): ask one short clarifying question instead of guessing; 'I don't know' / 'can't check' moves on to the next best question.
If a self-help tip didn't work, the diagnosis continues (the failed tip is an answer), with the questions left; then the likeliest technician cause.

Heating off too (q_radiators=yes): ask q_display first. F.22 → q_pressure; any other code → boiler_fault (heating technician); a dark display → q_power. Never ask about the gas stove: gas_supply_interrupted only if the tenant says the stove won't light either. Back from holiday or an electric heater in the flat: q_switch_check first.
One topic per question. If an answer contradicts an earlier one ('nobody used hot water', then 'as I was cooking'), clarify which is right before concluding.
